{{Youmay|energy cuffs, devices that employed [[Force field/Legends|energy fields]]|[[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]], similar devices made of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]}}
[[File:Energy_links.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in energy cuffs]]
'''Energy cuffs''' were an advanced form of wrist restraints, used to restrict the captive's movements. Unlike simple [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]], they held the captive's wrists together using an [[Force field/Legends|energy field]].

A pair of energy cuffs was used on [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] when she was captured on the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] by a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].
